'''Radiation deflector badges''' were industrial screeners used in high-[[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] laboratories and workplaces. They were capable of protecting the wearer from low and medium levels of radiation, although high doses of radiation could overwhelm it. [[Raflkind Industrials]] manufactured a [[Radiation Screener]] that was favored by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]].<ref name="ROE" />
